title: Follow revenue down to profit one step at a time
description: A waterfall adds each step to the running sum, so the reader sees where a total came from.
version: 0.0.1
styles: [scientific]
format: rmd/1
---

## Costs and tax take a third of revenue

These illustrative figures start from revenue, subtract costs and tax, add a grant and end at profit. The chart adds the steps up and nothing else; a total that disagrees with the sum is reported, not replaced.

```chart
type: waterfall
title: Profit is three quarters of revenue after a grant
subtitle: Thousands of dollars; each bar starts where the last one ended
data:
  inline:
    - step: Revenue
      amount: 120
      kind: start
    - step: Costs
      amount: -45.5
    - step: Tax
      amount: -14.5
    - step: Grant
      amount: 30
    - step: Profit
      amount: 90
      kind: total
encoding: {x: step, y: amount, measure: kind}
axes:
  y: {label: Amount, unit: k}
```

*Source: Illustrative values. Bars between the first and the last are signed changes.*

Use the keyboard or pointer to read each step's change and the running total it leads to.
